grouping: Mutually exclusive: five known files, then direct source CampaignStore/new Store/new HostIpc calls or bindings, then remaining files by area. Content criterion, not filename inference. No claim every store use is direct.
sampling: One-second /proc endpoints per actual single-file child process. Runner with 313 file arguments excluded. Durations are lower bounds; absent files have no duration, not zero measured work.

tap.mapping: TAP contains no filenames. No exact file attribution inferred from anonymous TAP test names. File groups use observed child processes; total top-level durations only cross-check suite work vs startup/loading/teardown.
